name: How long does the concrete driveway replacement process usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the concrete driveway replacement process usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete process for concrete driveway replacement typically takes 3 to 7 days from start to finish. This includes old driveway removal, site preparation, pouring the new concrete, and allowing for initial curing. However, the concrete needs at least 7 days to cure before it can withstand light vehicle traffic and up to 28 days to reach its full strength. Weather conditions can also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process usually takes 3 to 7 days, with light traffic possible after 7 days and full strength reached in 28 days.
